checks.name: LINK_ROW_EXISTS
checks.statement: every active trajectory carries an evidence-link row
checks.detail: a trajectory with no link row has no checkable evidence graph at all

checks.name: ENTRY_OBSERVATION_RESOLVES
checks.detail: 0 of 292 pre-repair values resolved, and none could: the namespaces were disjoint

checks.name: ENTRY_STEP_RESOLVES
checks.detail: the worker job that produced the leg must be reachable from the leg

checks.name: EXIT_LINKS_COMPLETE_OR_OPEN
checks.statement: a null exit link occurs only while the trajectory is open
checks.detail: a settled trajectory whose exit does not resolve has half an economic identity

checks.name: SNAPSHOT_HASH_IS_A_HASH
checks.statement: snapshot_hash is a sha256 digest, not a slot number
checks.detail: 292 of 292 pre-repair values were the decimal slot number

checks.name: FINGERPRINT_DISTINCT_FROM_SNAPSHOT
checks.statement: capability_fingerprint is not the snapshot hash
checks.detail: they answer different questions; 292 of 292 pre-repair rows had them identical

checks.name: RAW_STATE_PERSISTED
checks.statement: every linked job carries account manifests
checks.detail: no raw pre/post state means every amount is recorded once and unfalsifiable

checks.name: NO_UNEXPLAINED_PNL
checks.statement: no settlement publishes net PnL over a non-zero residue
checks.detail: 30 of 51 pre-repair rows with a residue published net PnL anyway

checks.name: TRAJECTORY_ECONOMICS_PRESENT
checks.statement: settled trajectories carry their economics columns
checks.detail: 0 of 292 pre-repair rows had any economics at all

checks.name: ENTRY_POLICIES_DECIDED
checks.statement: all three entry policies decided on each trajectory
checks.detail: the pre-repair corpus carried one entry policy label against three defined

checks.name: CAP_NOT_BREACHED
checks.statement: no mint exceeded its reservation cap
checks.detail: 15 mints exceeded a hard cap of 3; the worst produced 58

checks.name: NO_EVIDENCE_CONFLICTS
checks.detail: a recorded conflict is a second different answer that was refused; it needs resolving
